full_prompt_en: A square black and white editorial drawing portrays an older gray haired man from the chest upward, glaring toward the viewer while holding a rifle upright beside his left shoulder. His heavy eyebrows squeeze over narrowed eyes, a wide nose, and a deeply downturned mouth. Wavy hair rises in loose curls around the temples, and sharp wrinkles fold across his forehead, cheeks, and chin. He wears a dark suit jacket, pale shirt, and narrow tie. His hands grip the gun near the lower left corner, where the long metal barrel and front sight climb diagonally toward the upper left. The weapon's mechanical joints, magazine, and trigger area are sketched with small dark precision against the surrounding white paper. The man occupies most of the center and right side, but his shoulder and jacket dissolve into loose pen strokes at the bottom edge. The background is almost entirely blank, with no room or landscape visible. Strong imagined light from the upper left leaves broad white highlights along the hair, forehead, and gun, while dense crosshatching fills the undersides of the brows, mustache area, coat, and metal recesses. Short scratchy strokes animate the hair and fabric without closing all the contours. The extreme expression turns the image into an acerbic caricature, yet the observed facial modeling gives it weight. The overall composition is spare, forceful, and confrontational, built from black ink texture against bright untouched paper.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白编辑素描从胸部以上描绘一名年长灰发男子，他怒视观者，左肩旁竖举一支步枪。浓眉压住眯起的眼睛，鼻子宽大，嘴角深深向下。波浪头发在鬓角松松卷起，额头、面颊和下巴叠着尖锐皱纹。他穿深色西装外套、浅衬衫和窄领带。双手在左下角附近握住枪，长金属枪管与准星斜升向左上。枪的机械接合、弹匣与扳机附近在白纸前由细小深线准确速写。男子占了中央和右侧大部分，但肩膀与外套在底边散成松散钢笔笔划。背景几乎完全空白，没有可见室内或风景。想象的左上强光在头发、额头与枪上留下宽白高光，密集交叉排线填入眉下、唇上阴影、外套和金属凹处。短而带刮擦感的笔触活动了头发与布料，却没有封闭所有轮廓。极端神情使图像成为辛辣讽刺肖像，仔细观察的面部塑造又让它有分量。整体构图简洁、有力且直面观者，由黑墨肌理与亮白留纸建成。
style_prompt_en: Black and white editorial drawing uses dense crosshatching and assertive contour line on bright untouched paper. A large central dark mass is offset by a narrow diagonal mechanical silhouette, giving the compact composition tension. Angular folds and deeply cut marks concentrate near the focal zone, while peripheral edges fray into short exploratory strokes. White highlights are left as paper rather than painted, and gray values arise entirely from line density. Light appears to come from above one side, lifting raised planes and leaving the deepest shadow in narrow recesses. A nearly empty background keeps the graphic form immediate. Proportions are heightened but structurally convincing, and varied pen pressure brings both roughness and precision. The overall effect is acerbic, forceful, and tactile, with expressive exaggeration contained by disciplined draftsmanship.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白编辑素描在亮白留纸上使用密集交叉排线与果断轮廓。中央大深色体量由一道狭窄斜向机械剪影平衡，使紧凑构图充满张力。棱角褶纹与深刻笔痕集中在焦点附近，周边边缘碎成短促探索性笔划。白高光直接留纸而非上色，灰阶全由线条密度生成。光仿佛从上方一侧到来，抬亮凸面，让最深影停在窄凹处。近乎空白背景让图形即刻可读。比例受到强化但结构仍可信，变化的运笔压力带来粗糙与精确。整体辛辣、有力而可触，表达性夸张受到有纪律的画工约束。
